name: Generate Data and Deploy Pages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * 0'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pages-data
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Prepare build dirs
        run: |
          rm -rf .build _site
          mkdir -p .build/raw .build/enriched

      - name: Generate raw accident data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CITY_ARGS=()
          while IFS= read -r city; do
            city="$(echo "$city" | sed 's/#.*$//' | xargs)"
            [[ -z "$city" ]] && continue
            CITY_ARGS+=(--city "$city")
          done < cities.txt
          chmod +x ./convertAmt2gmaps.sh
          ./convertAmt2gmaps.sh \
            --outdir .build/raw \
            --limit 0 \
            "${CITY_ARGS[@]}" \
            --rad "" --pkw "" --fuss "" --krad ""

      - name: Validate raw accident data for all cities
        run: node scripts/check-data-paths.js --dir .build/raw --min-features 10

      - name: Restore context producer cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: .enrichment-cache
          # actions/cache cannot update an existing exact key. A per-run suffix
          # creates a writable snapshot while restore-keys reuse the newest
          # compatible producer cache from earlier runs.
          key: pages-context-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('scripts/producers/*.js', 'scripts/generate-context-city.js') }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            pages-context-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('scripts/producers/*.js', 'scripts/generate-context-city.js') }}-
            pages-context-${{ runner.os }}-
          save-always: true

      - name: Generate verified context data from scratch inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          while IFS= read -r city; do
            city="$(echo "$city" | sed 's/#.*$//' | xargs)"
            [[ -z "$city" ]] && continue
            node scripts/generate-context-city.js \
              --city "$city" \
              --input-dir .build/raw \
              --output-dir .build/enriched
          done < cities.txt

      - name: Build verified gzip-only accident tiles
        run: |
          node scripts/build-accident-tiles.js \
            --input-dir .build/enriched \
            --output-dir .build/enriched

      - name: Build canonical static site
        run: npm run build:site -- --input-dir .build/enriched --poi-dir out --output-dir _site

      - name: Materialize public browser profile with declared provenance gaps
        run: npm run build:pages-profile -- --site _site

      - name: Validate generated site and public distribution boundary
        run: |
          node scripts/validate-static-data.js \
            --dir _site/out \
            --gzip-only \
            --require-cities-file cities.txt \
            --min-features 10
          node scripts/check-context-datasets.js _site
          npm run validate:media -- --report out/qa/pages-documentation-media.json
          npm run validate:pages-profile -- --site _site

      - name: Record exact regenerated artifact fingerprint
        run: npm run fingerprint:site -- --site _site --write out/qa/pages-generated-profile.sha256

      - name: Install Chromium for public-profile smoke test
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Smoke-test the exact regenerated Pages artifact without rebuilding
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p out/qa
          npm run serve:site:existing > out/qa/pages-generated-server.log 2>&1 &
          server_pid=$!
          trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          ready=false
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:8000/werkbank_v2.html >/dev/null; then
              ready=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [[ "$ready" != true ]]; then
            cat out/qa/pages-generated-server.log >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
            npx playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.js --project=chromium

      - name: Prove browser smoke left the deployable artifact unchanged
        run: |
          npm run fingerprint:site -- --site _site --verify out/qa/pages-generated-profile.sha256
          npm run validate:pages-profile -- --site _site

      - name: Upload Pages media, browser and provenance QA evidence
        if: ${{ always() && hashFiles('_site/build-manifest.json') != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pages-documentation-media-report
          path: |
            out/qa/pages-documentation-media.json
            out/qa/pages-generated-profile.sha256
            out/qa/pages-generated-server.log
            _site/build-manifest.json
            _site/vendor/third-party-notices.json
            _site/vendor/sbom.cdx.json
            playwright-report
            test-results
          if-no-files-found: error

      # Policy reference for full ZIP/container releases. This step is
      # intentionally impossible for the reduced Pages profile: its excluded
      # capabilities are not delivered at all. Tag/manual publication paths
      # continue to execute this command and remain blocked by #406.
      - name: Full-distribution provenance gate is not applicable to reduced Pages profile
        if: ${{ false }}
        run: npm run validate:vendor-provenance -- --require-complete

      - name: Upload immutable Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Pin Pages source to GitHub Actions
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --method PUT "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages" -f build_type=workflow >/dev/null
          build_type="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages" --jq '.build_type')"
          test "$build_type" = workflow

      - name: Configure Pages deployment
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6

      - name: Deploy the previously validated artifact
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5

      - name: Verify published public profile and vendor assets
        env:
          PAGE_URL: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base="${PAGE_URL%/}"
          query="deployment=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}-${GITHUB_SHA}"
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            html_file="$(mktemp)"
            profile_ok=false
            capabilities_ok=false
            assets_ok=false
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                "${base}/werkbank_v2.html?${query}" > "$html_file"; then
              if grep -Fq 'name="unfallwerkbank:distribution-profile" content="public-preview-core-v1"' "$html_file"; then
                profile_ok=true
              fi
              if grep -Fq 'vendor/leaflet.heat/leaflet-heat.js' "$html_file" && \
                 grep -Fq 'vendor/leaflet-draw/leaflet.draw.js' "$html_file" && \
                 grep -Fq 'vendor/leaflet-image/leaflet-image.js' "$html_file" && \
                 grep -Fq 'vendor/export/docx.js' "$html_file" && \
                 grep -Fq 'vendor/export/pdfmake.js' "$html_file"; then
                capabilities_ok=true
              fi
              if curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/leaflet.markercluster/leaflet.markercluster.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/leaflet.heat/leaflet-heat.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/leaflet-draw/leaflet.draw.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/leaflet-image/leaflet-image.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/export/docx.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/export/pdfmake.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/export/pdfmake-fonts.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/vendor/export/file-saver.js?${query}" >/dev/null && \
                 curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                   --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
                   "${base}/js/ua.public-preview.js?${query}" >/dev/null; then
                assets_ok=true
              fi
            fi
            rm -f "$html_file"
            if [[ "$profile_ok" == true && "$capabilities_ok" == true && "$assets_ok" == true ]]; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Published Pages site did not expose the validated public profile at ${base}" >&2
          curl --silent --show-error --location --dump-header - \
            "${base}/werkbank_v2.html?${query}" | head -n 80 >&2 || true
          for asset in \
            vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js \
            vendor/leaflet.markercluster/leaflet.markercluster.js \
            vendor/leaflet.heat/leaflet-heat.js \
            vendor/leaflet-draw/leaflet.draw.js \
            vendor/leaflet-image/leaflet-image.js \
            vendor/export/docx.js \
            vendor/export/pdfmake.js \
            vendor/export/pdfmake-fonts.js \
            vendor/export/file-saver.js \
            js/ua.public-preview.js; do
            curl --silent --show-error --location --head \
              "${base}/${asset}?${query}" >&2 || true
          done
          exit 1
